dates_event_icons_wire: bodies Core answers on /v1/webadmin/dates_event_icons and
/v1/webadmin/dates_event_icons_save, icon contract version 2 (per-icon pin colours).

Source: Core commit 1bc768f46004b511d6cefed632e178526c9c7d3d (local, not yet
        published when captured on 2026-10-08; re-pin to the published commit that
        carries the same DatesEventIconService once it exists).
How:    WebadminDatesController::eventIcons() / ::saveEventIcons() were called
        in-process against a throwaway local replica-set mongod, with the form
        values the console's bridge sends (strings, the selector
        dates_event_icon_contract_version=2). Each file is the JSON value of the
        wire body, re-encoded with two-space indentation; nothing was edited.

dates_event_icons-bootstrap.json          read before anything is stored (revision 0, the 17 defaults)
dates_event_icons_save.request            the form of the save below (icons is the JSON text that was sent)
dates_event_icons_save.json               its receipt (revision 1, idempotency_replayed false)
dates_event_icons_save-replay.json        the same form sent again (idempotency_replayed true)
dates_event_icons.json                    read after the save
dates_event_icons_save-stale.json         the same catalogue against revision 0 under a new key
dates_event_icons_save-name-invalid.json  an empty name
dates_event_icons-contract-v1.json        the read as contract version 1 answers it (no colour key);
                                          this console must refuse it

A file's route is its name up to the first "-".
